lines.en: Sound of gnawing on decayed corpses
Walking and screaming, my throat is raw.
My scream draws all my kin.

lines.zh: 我吸一口气，就准备尖叫。
lines.en: I take one breath and get ready to shriek.

lines.zh: 你在这儿，我这就叫人来。
lines.en: There you are, I will call the others.

lines.zh: 痛苦中发出微弱的尖啸
尖啸声中，你感受到一股腐烂的诱惑。
lines.en: The shriek makes you feel the decayed temptation.

lines.zh: 你被那尖锐的叫声勾引了。
lines.en: The sharp shriek pulls you in.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中蕴含着死亡的诱惑。
lines.en: Its shriek carries the temptation of death.

lines.zh: 仿佛被它的尖啸声吸引。
lines.en: You seem drawn to its shriek.

lines.zh: 它的声音像是一种腐烂的呼唤。
lines.en: Its voice is a call of decay.

lines.zh: 你的脚步不由自主地向着它挪动。
lines.en: Your steps move towards it involuntarily.

lines.zh: 它在嘶喊着想要吞噬你。
你仿佛被它的声音控制了。
lines.en: You feel controlled by its voice.

lines.zh: 你被那恐怖的叫声深深吸引。
lines.en: You are drawn in by its terrifying shriek.

lines.zh: 你被它的尖啸声吓住了。
lines.en: You are frightened by its shriek.

lines.zh: 你撞上了僵尸，尖啸回响。
lines.en: You collide with a zombie, and a shriek echoes.
You are hit by its shriek.

lines.zh: 它的尖啸在你耳边炸响。
lines.en: Its shriek explodes in your ears.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它，尖啸随之而来。
lines.en: You collide with it, and a shriek follows.

lines.zh: 它的尖啸声让你头晕目眩。
你被它的攻击撞飞，尖啸随之响起。
lines.en: You are knocked away by its attack, and a shriek sounds.
You collide with it, and a shriek resounds.

lines.zh: 你被它的力量撞飞，尖啸声响起。
lines.en: You are sent flying by its power, and a shriek sounds.

lines.zh: 你撞上它的身体，尖啸声随之而来。
lines.en: You collide with its body, and a shriek follows.

lines.zh: 它的力量让你撞飞，尖啸声随之响起。
lines.en: Its power sends you flying, and a shriek sounds.
It lets out a mating shriek.

lines.zh: 我一叫，附近的都往这跑。
lines.en: One shriek and every zombie nearby comes running.

lines.zh: 它在求偶时发出尖锐的叫声。
lines.en: It lets out a sharp shriek while mating.

lines.zh: 它的求偶尖啸声在空气中回荡。
lines.en: Its mating shriek echoes through the air.

lines.zh: 它在求偶时发出令人不安的尖啸。
lines.en: It emits an unsettling shriek while mating.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中充满了求偶的欲望。
lines.en: Its shriek is filled with mating desire.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的尖啸声，吸引同伴。
lines.en: It emits a mating shriek to attract companions.

lines.zh: 它的求偶尖啸声穿透了黑暗。
lines.en: Its mating shriek cuts through the darkness.

lines.zh: 它在求偶时发出尖锐的嘶叫声。
lines.en: It lets out a sharp screech while mating.

lines.zh: 发出尖啸，仿佛灵魂在哭泣。
lines.en: Screams like a soul in agony.

lines.zh: 尖啸着靠近你，似乎想吞噬你。
lines.en: Screams as it closes in, like it wants to consume you.

lines.zh: 饥饿地尖叫着，寻找食物。
lines.en: Cries out in hunger, searching for food.

lines.zh: 周围的尸块被它的尖啸吸引。
lines.en: Corpse fragments are drawn by its scream.

lines.zh: 发出尖啸，仿佛想要警告同类。
尖啸中带着死亡的气息。
lines.en: Its scream carries the stench of death.

lines.zh: 尖叫着爬向目标，速度加快。
lines.en: Screams and speeds towards the target.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶尖叫，仿佛地狱的回响。

lines.en: Screams incessantly when it spots you.
Screams as it locks on to you.

lines.zh: 尖啸中透露出贪婪与欲望。
注视你片刻后尖啸起来。
lines.en: Screams after a moment of staring at you.

lines.zh: 注视你片刻后开始尖叫。
lines.en: Stares at you for a moment then screams.
I open my mouth and wake the whole wood.

lines.zh: 你听见了吗？不止我一个。
lines.en: You hear that? There's more than me.

lines.zh: 这一声喊的是我的兄弟。
lines.en: This call is for my brothers.
I found a living one—come over!
One more scream and they'll all be here.
My scream echoes in your skull.
I hold still, waiting for kin.
This shriek is for those above.
Screaming as it attacks your throat!
Snarling as it bites off your hand!
Screaming as it charges your face!
Snarling as it gnaws your bones!
Screaming as it rips your flesh!
I bite you and keep screaming.
My scream makes your hands shake.
My voice cracks, but I still lunge.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我喊十个来。
lines.en: Hit me once, I call ten.
Screaming as it emerges from the ground!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从坟墓中爬出！
lines.en: Snarling as it emerges from the grave!
Screaming as it rises from the ground!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从腐尸中爬出！
lines.en: Snarling as it emerges from the rot!
Screaming as it crawls from the mound!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从阴暗处出现！
lines.en: Snarling as it appears from the shadows!
Screaming as it crawls from the dark!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从坟茔中爬出！
lines.en: Snarling as it emerges from the tomb!

lines.zh: 尖啸着从地下墓室中出现！
lines.en: Screaming as it emerges from the crypt!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着从荒冢中爬出！
lines.en: Snarling as it crawls from the ruin!
A scream comes out of the dirt first.

lines.zh: 我难得出现，叫声却很远。
lines.en: I spawn seldom, but my scream carries far.
The horde has one more screamer.
The scream comes first, the body after.

lines.zh: 从洞里摔下来，尖啸都哑了。
lines.en: Fell down the shaft and my shriek went hoarse.

lines.zh: 尖啸声中带着痛苦，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pained shriek — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 一声绝望的尖叫，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Desperate scream — and the explosion makes it worse.
